message.content:
This editorial illustration is the front cover of Tempo magazine. A vertical red bar runs down the left edge. The top features text: "LOBI TINGKAT TINGGI SINGAPORE AIRLINES," a vertical dividing line, and "BROTOSENO DAN KASUS SAWAH FIKTIF." Below, the large white word "TEMPO" is overlaid by a logo commemorating 45 years (1971-2016) and the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The central image, viewed through a glass surface covered in clear raindrops, shows a vast outdoor gathering. In the background, a tall, light-colored obelisk-like monument stands under a cloudy, overcast sky. In the foreground and middle ground, hundreds of people are positioned close together on the ground. Most wear white or light-colored clothing, including head coverings like caps and hijabs. Many are bowed forward in a kneeling or prostrate position.

Large, bold white text in the lower right reads "KARENA MAKAR SETITIK..." The bottom left corner contains a barcode, the date "5-11 DESEMBER 2016," the price "RP 45.000," and the magazine's website URL. The overall scene is captured from a slightly elevated perspective.
